risk_note: RV1/RV2 (catalog favorites, app.module assembly). D10-311 ②, 08 BR-ID-28 (favorites are deleted with the account): catalog's deletion cleanup port deleteFavoritesForUser runs on identity's cleanup transaction (users row already locked; no own transaction, no commit), takes the same per-user advisory lock as the favorites writes and deletes the user's app.favorites rows by app_id and user_id; re-entrant (a retry or a concurrent run deletes nothing more and does not fail). The lock and delete core are shared with B1-28b's deleteAllFavoritesOfUser, whose behaviour is unchanged ([AC-B1-28b#34]). app.module's deletionCleanupPorts.catalog changes from the unavailable marker to this port. couli_app already has DELETE on app.favorites; no migration. No money, no attribution.
